known_mismatch.reason: Accepted deviation (reference/deviations.md, Engine: "Warnings of compiled PHP code"): PHP folds `NAN . "]"` while compiling the template class (zend_try_ct_eval_binary_op(); zend_binary_op_produces_error() does not count NAN, PHPSRC/Zend/zend_compile.c:9962) and warns then (zend_double_to_str(): `unexpected NAN value was coerced to string`). With a filesystem cache Twig includes the class with `@include_once` (TWIG/src/Cache/FilesystemCache.php:49), which silences the warning: the oracle records it with "silenced": true and the diff skips it (T12 of plans/parity-fixes.md would turn this into an accepted deviation). twig-rs raises it when the expression runs. The control without a cache matches: there PHP warns while eval()ing the class.
